title: OECS Connector Definitions
description: Defines a single physical charge connector (plug or socket) exposed by a charger, including its electrical ratings and cable characteristics.

cable.description: Characteristics of the attached charging cable, if the connector has one permanently attached (as opposed to a socket requiring the driver's own cable).

attached.description: True if a cable is permanently attached to the charger; false if the connector is a bare socket.

retractable.description: True if the cable retracts into the housing (reel/management system) when not in use.

cooling.description: Cable cooling method; liquid-cooled cables are common on high-power DC connectors.

connector.description: A single physical connector on the charger.

label.description: Human-readable label for this connector within the model spec, e.g. 'Connector 1', 'CCS2 outlet'. Not required to be unique; array order/position is not semantically meaningful, so use the label plus type/currentType to distinguish connectors when needed.

phases.description: Number of AC phases used by this connector. Omit for DC connectors.

ratedVoltage.description: Rated voltage range for this connector.

ratedCurrent.description: Maximum current this connector can deliver.

maxPower.description: Maximum power this connector can deliver.

connectorLock.description: Whether the connector has an electromechanical lock actuated during charging.

meterAccuracyClass.description: Metering accuracy class of this connector's dedicated meter. Omit if this connector has no dedicated meter (see hardware.meter for the charger's primary meter).

meterAccuracyClassOtherName.description: Required when meterAccuracyClass is 'other'; the classification as printed on the datasheet.

isoPlugAndCharge.description: Whether this connector supports ISO 15118 Plug & Charge authentication.

bidirectional.description: Whether this connector supports bidirectional power flow (V2G/V2H/V2L).
